content: प्रणिहित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Laid on, applied. .²2 Deposited. .²3 Outstretched, stretched forth; मामाकाशप्रणिहितभुजं निर्दयाश्लेषहेतोः <ls>Me. 108</ls>. .²4 Consigned, delivered, entrusted. .²5 Having the attention fixed upon one object, with the mind concentrated, intent; ऋजुः प्रणिहितो गच्छंस्त्रसस्थावर-वर्जकः <ls>Mb. 12. 9. 19</ls>. .²6 Determined, decided. .²7 Cautious, wary. .²8 Obtained, attained. .²9 Spied out. .²10 Acknowledged, admitted, stated; सम्यक् प्रणिहितं चार्थं पृष्टः सन्नाभिनन्दति <ls>Ms. 8. 54</ls>. .²11 Applied, directed; प्रियायास्मै धाम्ने प्रणिहितनमस्योऽस्मि भवते <ls>Śivamahimna 28</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>).
